analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We disclose personal data: to marketers and advertisers, including for the purpose of creating and delivering personalized marketing and advertising messages.

analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: We disclose personal data: to business partners to offer some services, such as email and payment processing.

analysis.headline: Generates Your Inferences/Insights
analysis.quote: We process data in connection with our business and services to generate inferences and insights that may be linked to a specific person, including through the use of data analytics and artificial intelligence.

analysis.headline: Ignores 'Do Not Track'
analysis.quote: There are no generally accepted standards for this feature and we do not respond to “Do Not Track” signals.

analysis.headline: Collects Data From Other Sources
analysis.quote: Examples of personal data obtained from other sources include publicly available data, social media information, and information lawfully gathered by third party data providers.

analysis.headline: Cannot Manage All Identifiers
analysis.quote: We do not offer the ability to manage mandatory identifiers, because such identifiers are essential to providing our products and services.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for Business Needs
analysis.quote: We retain personal data for our business needs and to comply with law.

analysis.headline: Changes May Reduce Your Rights
analysis.quote: If we change this global privacy notice, it will apply to personal data collected prior to adoption of the new statement only to the extent as the new statement does not reduce the rights of affected data subjects.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Internationally
analysis.quote: We transfer personal data internationally to operate our business and provide services.
